from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class TradingFinancialAssets(BaseModel):
    """A single 'trading financial assets' record from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name that this financial document belongs to")
    document_period: str | None = Field(description="The period covered by this financial document")
    balance_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of balance: '期末' (ending) or '期初' (beginning)")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The trading financial assets amount, or null if not reported")
    amount_raw: str | None = Field(description="The raw amount string as written (e.g. '435,234,790.00' or '-' or empty)")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g. '元')")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short excerpt from the document showing this data point")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Extract all relevant financial data points from all documents."""
    trading_financial_assets_records: list[TradingFinancialAssets]
